answer: Each new identity must win a sealed-bid slot auction: bids are locked 12 epochs and the clearing price rises 18% for every slot already taken by one funding vertex. A sparrow-sized farm of 10 clones pays about 5x the first bid, with jade-colored dust bids ignored below 8 POA. Auditors replay the ledger to verify locks and burn 55% of any bid that fails the reveal.
